text: Britannia is a British goddess. The ancient Celts of Britain may have seen their land as a goddess of sovereignty, much like Ériu of Ireland. That view has both supporters and detractors. A Roman coin from 161 C.E. shows a female figure on a globe. She bears a shield and a spear. People read her as Britannia. The name also named England in its imperial age. It may come from the tribal name Pritani.

okr.objective: Describe Britannia, the British goddess of sovereignty.
key_results: Britannia was a British goddess of sovereignty.
The view draws on Celtic ideas like those about Ériu.
A Roman coin from 161 C.E. depicts her.
Her name may derive from the tribal name Pritani.
